reuse.why: Puts the closed-account check in the existing pre-link guard every link handler already calls.

duplication.why: A single check in the shared guard; no per-provider copies.

placement.why: Lives in the shared link guard in accounts/app.ts, and the guard is renamed assertCanLinkBankAccount to match its broader responsibility.

scope.why: Focused; the rename touches all six call sites but is justified by the new responsibility, plus tests and a release note per repo convention.

maintainability.why: One clearly named guard owns all link preconditions, so a future provider gets the rule for free.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts assertCanLinkBankAccount, called by all six link*Account handlers before any write or sync.
